name: Most popular names in the Philippines (Kaggle, jorizivannvillanueva)
covers: The 1,000 most common Philippine forenames with the number of bearers, a 1-in-N frequency, and the gender split for each
note: One snapshot with no stated collection date, no time dimension and no regional split. Multiplying incidence by frequency implies a population base of about 106.0 million, which dates it to roughly 2019-2020 — an inference from the data, not a claim by the source.
